paite: Philistia mite'n asepaih tengteng uh Aphek ah akaikhawm vek ua, Israel mite'n Jezreel a tuikhuk kiang ah panmun akhoh uhi,
heading: Philistiate'n David Adeih Kei Uh
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek; and the Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

paite: Philistia makaite azaza in, asangsang in apai ua, David leh amite'n Akish toh anung uh azui uhi.
english: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands; and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

paite: Philistia makaite'n, "Hiai Hebrute'n bang ahia ahih uh?" achi uhi. Akish in Philistia makai kiang ah, "Hiai David Israelte kumpipa Saul sikha, hichi tan a ka kiang a om khin a, ka kiang a, ahong lut nung a lah tutan a leng adiklouhna ka muhlouhna pa ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines said, “What about these Hebrews?” Achish said to the princes of the Philistines, “Isn’t this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me these days, or rather these years? I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today.”

paite: Himahleh Philistia kumpipate atung ah aheh uhi. Philistia kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi na mun sehsak a pai ding in kiksak inla, kidouna ah i kiang uah hong suk kei heh. Huchi lou in zaw kidouna ah i melmate lam ah apang kha ding. Hiai mite lu ding in hiai mipa leh apu kilem nawn ve un teh aw?
english: But the princes of the Philistines were angry with him; and the princes of the Philistines said to him, “Make the man return, that he may go back to his place where you have appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to us. For with what should this fellow reconcile himself to his lord? Should it not be with the heads of these men?

paite: Hiai David mah ahi kei maw, Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chi a, atungtang thu la a asak uh?" achi uhi.
english: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands’?”

paite: Huchi in Akish in David asam a, akiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Midik mahmah na hi a, sepaihte lak a ka kiang a na kuan leh na hong leltak ka mitmuh in ahoih mahmah hi. Ka kiang a na hong ni a pan tuni tan in na tung ah bangmah hoihlouhna himhim ka mu het kei hi. Himahleh makaite'n ahon ngai kei uhi.
english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

paite: Huaiziak in Philistia kumpipate na hihlungkim louhlouhna ding in kik inla, lungkimtak in pai in," achi hi.
english: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”

paite: David in Akish kiang ah, "Ahihleh, bang thil ahia ka na hih? Na kiang a ka om sung teng tuni tan in, ka toupa kumpipa melma dou lou a ka kik nawn maimah ding, na sikha tung ah bang mu na hia oi?" achi hi.
english: David said to Achish, “But what have I done? What have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?”

paite: Akish in adawng a, David kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in Pathian angel bang in na hoih chih ka thei hi. Himahleh Philistia kumpipate'n, kidouna ah i kiang ah ahong sam kei ding, achi bikbek mawk uhi.
english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang a om na pu sikhate toh zingkhang in thou unla, zingkhang a na thoh phet ua khua avak chiang in pai un," achi hi.
english: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light, depart.”

paite: Huchi in David leh amite Philistia gam a kik nawn ding a zingsang a pawtkhe ding in athouta uh. Jezreel ah Philistia mite ahohtou uhi.
english: So David rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines; and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
